optimizedDescription.value: Translates Python source and stubs into deterministic symbols, bindings, references, imports, calls, construction, and hierarchy facts.

optimizedContext.value:
# python-language-adapter

## Rules

### Files & analysis
- PythonLanguageAdapter handles .py and .pyi as python.
- Parse supplied content once via registered Tree-sitter/ast-grep grammar; return complete FileAnalysisDraft: symbols, imports, binding/call/reference facts, compact serializable Pass 2 state.
- Never import/execute analyzed modules. Parser objects only run-scoped keepalive; never persisted.

### Declarations & identity
- Extract module functions, classes/nested classes, class-body methods including decorated definitions, module/class assignment targets.
- Class assignments, dataclass fields, Protocol annotations become SymbolKind.Property with enclosing class owner and parentId. Nested functions unsupported.
- Preserve attached comments. Use complete construct range and exact declared-name selectionRange, half-open; omit when authoritative range unavailable.
- Owner from syntactic nesting: method -> nearest class; nested class -> nearest class; module declaration -> no owner. Omit unprovable-owner methods from logical member facts.
- Create/map owner identities before member logical IDs; never copy raw parser IDs or optional SymbolNode.parentId. Same-name methods across classes remain distinct.
- Preserve distinct evidence for instance/class/static methods, properties, setters, other recognized forms; never guess unknown decorators.

### Imports & resolution
- Extract import, from-import, aliases, relative imports, literal importlib.import_module() and __import__(); drop computed arguments.
- For import package.module, retain local binding and original qualified module.
- Resolve relative imports using leading-dot traversal and indexed proof across modules, package __init__.py, stubs, known src layouts. Ambiguous namespace/layout routes unresolved.
- resolutionManifests() returns only pyproject.toml. Package identity only nearest bounded [project].name, underscore/hyphen normalized; never setup.cfg, setup.py, or other tables.

### Bindings, calls & types
- Emit deterministic lexical scope, import alias, parameter/return annotation, annotated assignment, type-alias RHS, self/cls receiver, explicit construction, and proven local-alias facts.
- Extract function/class decorator calls/references and class/dataclass field annotations; emit CALLS or USES_TYPE when resolvable.
- Emit IMPORTS, CALLS, CONSTRUCTS, USES_TYPE only for one proven indexed target.
- Caller = innermost enclosing function/method, or class for class decorator. No guessed module calls, monkey patches, descriptors, reflection, computed imports, runtime-flow aliases.

### Hierarchy & provenance
- Retain bases in source order; resolve via local declarations/proven imports.
- Proven ordinary inheritance -> EXTENDS; proven protocol/interface-like base MAY -> IMPLEMENTS; known matching member -> OVERRIDES.
- Reference facts identify child/ancestor logical owners, relation kind, base order, ordered provenance; resolver traverses ancestor owner then queries member. Never emit ancestor owner as member candidate.
- Preserve only provable multiple-inheritance precedence. C3 MRO, descriptors, dynamic __mro_entries__, metaclass-dependent selection remain ambiguous/unresolved. Cycles terminate deterministically.

### Public surface, stubs & capabilities
- Module declarations addressable through module surface. Imports/aliases remain local unless supported syntax/metadata proves public route.
- .pyi declarations participate without speculative runtime merge/execution.
- Static __all__, star expansion, namespace aggregation, runtime mutation unsupported. Never infer export from missing leading underscore.
- Advertise hierarchy: true only while required hierarchy/provenance emitted; build-context false until environment/platform/interpreter/layout policy consumed.
- Parse failure/unsupported semantics become shared coverage outcomes, never name-only guesses.
- Identical content/index context produces deterministic facts, relations, provenance.

## Constraints
- MUST NOT execute Python, import analyzed modules, or inspect runtime objects.
- Monkey patching, dynamic attribute hooks, reflection, whole-program alias flow unsupported.
- Python-specific import, ownership, hierarchy semantics remain inside adapter.
